name: useDataTableState
description: A comprehensive hook for managing data table state including pagination, sorting, and row selection with automatic state synchronization.
usage_guidelines: Use with DataTable component for state management.
Handles pagination, page size, sorting, and row selection.
Automatically clears selection when pagination changes.
Provides handlers for all table interactions.
Works with both client-side and server-side data.

params.name: props
params.description: Configuration object with paging state, callbacks, and selection state.

return_value.description: Object containing all table interaction handlers.

onPageSizeChange.description: Handler for page size changes (resets to page 1).

Dont: Don't forget to handle selection state
